_note: «إياب» / Eyab — the Armada Residence membership (Ahmed, 6 Nov 2026 — DECISIONS.md 2026-11-06 «إياب»; it replaces «نادي أرمادا ريزيدنس», 3 Nov 2026). The name is always written «إياب» with the hamza under the alif (never «اياب»), "Eyab" in English, and is always presented with its fixed descriptor «إياب — عضوية أرمادا ريزيدنس» / "Eyab — Armada Residence membership" (the first mention on every page, email and screen; later mentions in the same text may say «إياب» alone). «نادي أرمادا», «نادي أرمادا ريزيدنس», "Armada Residence Club" and "Armada Club" are forbidden in guest text (qa.py). The slogan «حيّاك دايم» is a deliberate exception to the Modern Standard Arabic rule, allowed only as this slogan. /club/ and club.armadaresidence.com keep their addresses (printed QR codes). The consent text is ONE text for both offers (WhatsApp, email) and ads (hashed upload to ad platforms); every stored consent names its version (public.consent_texts). A new wording = a new version here AND in a migration (consent_texts), never an edit of an existing one. Copy approved by Ahmed (6 Nov 2026) except the texts DECISIONS.md lists as for approval.

consent._previous: versions a page loaded before a wording change may still send; the functions accept them and record the one the guest saw (2026-11-03 = the longer first wording, Ahmed 3 Nov 2026; 2026-11-04 = the short wording followed by «التفاصيل»)
